module origen_065456(
    input wire clk_50Mhz,
    input wire reset,
    input wire write0,
    input wire write1,
    output reg LED,
    output reg ready
);

    reg [12:0] count;
    reg resetStatus, write1Status, write0Status, clear;

    always @(posedge clk_50Mhz) begin
        if (reset && !resetStatus) begin
            resetStatus <= 1;
            ready <= 0;
            count <= 0;
        end else if (write1 && !write1Status && ready) begin
            write1Status <= 1;
            ready <= 0;
            count <= 0;
        end else if (write0 && !write0Status && ready) begin
            write0Status <= 1;
            ready <= 0;
            count <= 0;
        end else if (clear) begin
            resetStatus <= 0;
            write1Status <= 0;
            write0Status <= 0;
            clear <= 0;
            ready <= 1;
        end else begin
            count <= count + 1;
        end

        if (resetStatus) begin
            LED <= 0;
            if (count == 3999) clear <= 1;
        end else if (write1Status) begin
            if (count < 50) LED <= 1;
            else LED <= 0;
            if (count == 61) clear <= 1;
        end else if (write0Status) begin
            if (count < 12) LED <= 1;
            else LED <= 0;
            if (count == 61) clear <= 1;
        end else begin
            LED <= 0;
        end
    end

endmodule
